::: {#rem-surprisal-meaning}
#### Unlikely outcomes carry more information

The [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of a [value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization) is large
when the value was unlikely,
and it falls to $0$ as the value becomes certain.
Correctly guessing heads on one toss of a fair coin is worth $1$ [bit](#def-bit);
correctly guessing ten heads in a row is worth $10$ [bits](#def-bit).

:::
